name: arcus-jit
description: Catch a change before review, after Meta's just-in-time catching tests: run the story's tests on the change and its merge base on your own stack, have a fresh-session agent write tests that try to break it, have a judge subagent rule on what fails on the change alone, and record your fix-or-ship choice in one PR comment. Needs the arcus plugin and the Arcus CLI.
